summary: Wheaton Precious Metals Corp. filed a Form 6-K on July 6, 2026, announcing the release date of its 2026 second quarter results on August 6, 2026, after market close, and a conference call on August 7, 2026. The filing contains no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or any special-situation event; it is a routine earnings release notification.
